_readme: Golden results from the four reference exports (prod, acc, stg, tst) with PROD as baseline, WITH parameter defaults applied (unset = default; profiles do NOT inherit from each other). Produced by Compare-PsoSysFiles.ps1 and verified against the Python reference (effective_values_reference.py + workbook_builder_reference.py). The sample XML files are NOT in this package (customer data); Ish keeps them locally. Before defaults were applied the totals were 837 / 218 / 301 / 389 / 488 - that raw comparison overstated differences and is retired.
spotChecks: Parameters: RoutingApiKey is shown as [API key set] everywhere; the actual key value is identical in every environment and must never appear in any output
Parameters: DEFAULT/ActivityBaseLabel in STG starts with a space; it must be shown with the visible whitespace marker U+2423
Exception Types: DEFAULT type 90 attention = 10 / 2 / 10 / 2
Groups: ST_Ops_Mgr (PROD, ACC) and ST_Ops_MGR (STG, TST) are ONE merged group (19 distinct groups across all four) and the spelling difference is flagged
Group Permissions: PROD has 341 rows, 241 of them explicit denies (allow=false). PROD ST_Dispatch / Administrator is allow=false, allow_edit=true -> displayed 'F / T'
Travel: ACC has 343 polygons and 1 travel-time weighting row (time zone America/Regina); PROD has 2 polygons; STG and TST have none
Table counts: Users rows = 147 / 262 / 99 / 129 (PROD / ACC / STG / TST) - shown in counts but never compared
Distinct parameter_ids across the four files = 41 and every one has a definition
DEFAULTS - AllowSplitTravel: PROD explicit True; ACC/STG/TST unset. Catalog default is True -> status 'Same (default)', cells show True / (default: True) ...; NOT a difference
DEFAULTS - CommittedActivitiesConstraintsOption: PROD unset, others 1; catalog default 1 -> 'Same (default)'
DEFAULTS - GpsFrequency: ACC 'PT5M' vs default 'PT0H5M0S' (TIMESPAN) -> same effective value (300 s); must be 'Same (default)'
DEFAULTS - SchedulingWindowLength: TST 'P2D' = default 'P2D' -> same
DEFAULTS - StandardSendScheduleExceptionAccepts: ACC 'False' vs default 'false' (BOOLEAN, case-insensitive) -> same as PROD/STG; TST True is the only difference
DEFAULTS - ImplicitBreaksOnOffEventsRequired: PROD True; ACC/STG unset (default False); TST False -> DIFF (PROD only)
DEFAULTS - SortValuePrecedenceMaximumStatus: PROD 40, STG 40, ACC/TST unset (default 30) -> DIFF
DEFAULTS - CommitToAllocatedShift: PROD False, STG False (= default), ACC True, TST True -> DIFF; PROD and STG are effectively equal
DEFAULTS - TravelTimeProfileId (DEFAULT profile): PROD unset -> '(default: DEFAULT)'; ACC 'Default'; TST 'DEFAULT' (case-sensitive STRING compare: ACC differs)
DEFAULTS - RealTimeTravelProvider (DEFAULT profile): NONE everywhere effectively (default NONE) -> 'Same (default)'
Parameters CSV/HTML have a Default column (catalog default, '(blank)' for empty) and the Definition column uses the catalog description unless a KB-backed built-in definition exists

NO INHERITANCE - the PROD STRAIGHTLINE profile has no parameters set: TravelCalculationOption shows '(default: StraightLine)' (the catalog default, NOT the DEFAULT profile's HierarchicalTravelMatrix); it equals TST's explicit StraightLine. ACC and STG have no STRAIGHTLINE profile -> '(no profile)'
mutationTests: Change TST latest version rows to 6.16.0.33 -> red banner, 'Same release (6.16), different patch builds', TST BEHIND
Change STG to a 6.15.x latest version -> red banner, 'Different RELEASES', STG BEHIND
6.13.0.9 must sort as OLDER than 6.13.0.67 (numeric version compare, never string compare)
Remove System_Version from one file -> warning, version unknown, no false green banner
Upload a file with an unknown parameter -> row shows '(no definition yet)' and appears in the missing-definitions template
Two uploads given the same name, no baseline selected, or two baselines selected -> blocked in the UI with a clear message
Remove pso_parameters_reference.csv -> warning, unset parameters show '(absent)', no 'Same (default)' rows, report says defaults were NOT applied
Parameter not in the catalog and unset in one environment -> '(absent)', and it counts as different from an explicit value
Same parameter_id under two application types (e.g. JsonFormatVersion in two apps) -> two rows, matched to the right catalog entry by application
A non-DEFAULT profile that leaves a parameter unset while the DEFAULT profile sets it explicitly -> the non-DEFAULT cell shows the catalog default, never the DEFAULT profile's value
